thread:
DeployBot: ALERT: dedicated-eu-1 dedicated pool embeddings p95 and error-rate spike after deploy. Auto-rollback attempted but blocked by pool pin. https://dash.redwood/alerts/6954 :rotating_light:
Lina: spotting 2.6x p95 and a sharp increase in 5xx on the dedicated pool. This is customers-only (dedicated).
Priya: logs show a regression in the new kernel selector for quantized path; affects dedicated runtime binaries.
Lina: because this is a pinned dedicated pool, auto-rollback couldn't proceed. Rolling back whole fleet is not acceptable (hosted unaffected). We should consider a targeted partial revert for the dedicated pool only. OpsLead?
OpsLead: agree. Proposed path: 1) lock change window and release-notes freeze; 2) notify affected account managers & CS; 3) run targeted partial rollback on dedicated-eu-1 to previous stable revision; 4) monitor for 10m; if metrics recover, keep rollback and schedule full revert plan for non-dedicated if needed. Require two approvals: OpsLead + ReleaseManager.
Support: prepping customer advisory for impacted tenants; will include ETA and mitigation steps.
ReleaseManager: confirm approvals required. Post the exact rollback CLI and thresholds.
OpsLead: CLI snippet: ```
# targeted rollback for dedicated pool only
deployctl rollback --pool=dedicated-eu-1 --to-rev=2026-03-20-1030 --partial=true --require-approvals=2
# monitor p95, 5xx_rate, cpu_usage for 10m. Success if p95 < 1.3x baseline and 5xx_rate < 0.5% within 10m
```
Lina: I'll request the rollback and get approvals. EngOncall, please post metric screenshots every 2 minutes and watch for thrashing.
EngOncall: starting observation window. 2m: p95 2.5x, 5xx 1.6%.
ReleaseManager: OpsLead + ReleaseManager approvals granted. Lina, proceed and tag the release notes: "targeted revert executed on dedicated-eu-1 to restore stability; investigating kernel selector regression".
Lina: executing: `deployctl rollback --pool=dedicated-eu-1 --to-rev=2026-03-20-1030 --partial=true`
DeployBot: Action acknowledged: targeted rollback started for dedicated-eu-1. https://deploy.redwood/actions/6954321000/rollback
EngOncall: 4m after rollback: p95 down to 1.15x baseline, 5xx 0.3%. Continuing 10m health checks.
Support: customer notes dispatched to impacted accounts. Will post copy to thread.
OpsLead: keep change window locked for 60m. Create incident stub and follow-up postmortem: https://docs.redwood/incident/695432-dedicated-partial-revert. Good coordination, team.
